```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-workflow
%%| fig-cap: "A simple workflow diagram showing step A leading to step B."


flowchart LR
    classDef dashedNode stroke-dasharray: 5 5

    AT>Anaesthetic Technique]
    TIVA((TIVA))
    MD((Morphine Dose))
    FD((Fentanyl Dose))
    WT((Weight))
    HT((Height))
   
    OC((Previous Opioid use))
    ETH(Ethnicity)
    OAC((Opioid Concentration)):::dashedNode
    SE((Surgeon Exp))
    SS((Surgical Skill)):::dashedNode
    SI((Surgical Site))
    SHD((Surgical Harm Damage)):::dashedNode
    COB((Coblation))
    LOSurg((Length of Surgery))
    SED((Sedation)):::dashedNode
    NAU((Nausea)):::dashedNode
    PAIN((Pain)):::dashedNode
    TOD(Time of day)
    ON[Overnight Stay]
    LOS[LOS]
    LIR[Length in Recovery]
    RR[Rescue analgesia]
    RD((Remifentanil Dose))
    PD((Propofol dose))

    subgraph PV[Patient Variables]
        WT((Weight))
        HT((Height))
        ETH(Ethnicity)
        OC
    end


    subgraph PV2[Anaesthesia Variables]
    TIVA
    MD
    FD
    RD
    RD
    end

      subgraph PV3[Surgical Variables]
    SS
    SI
    SE
    SHD
    COB
    LOSurg
    end

    AT --> TIVA
    AT --> MD
    AT --> OAC

    TIVA --> RD
    RD --> OAC
    TIVA --> PD
    PD --> SED

    MD --> OAC
    FD --> OAC
    WT --> OAC
    HT --> OAC
    OC --> OAC
    ETH --> OAC
    OAC --> SED
    OAC --> NAU
    OAC --> PAIN
    SE --> SS
    SS --> SHD
    SI --> SHD
    COB --> SHD
    LOSurg --> SHD
    SHD --> PAIN
    PAIN --> RR
    RR --> LIR
    SED --> LOS
    SED --> LIR
    NAU --> LOS
    NAU --> LIR
    TOD ---> ON
    LOS --> ON


```
